comparison.objective: Level a floor sleeper by inserting a tapered shim under its low end.
comparison.physical_skill: Lift a loaded member, start and advance a shim by a controlled amount, and use a bubble level as feedback.
comparison.success_condition: The sleeper is supported with full shim bearing and within 1 mm end-to-end level, with the level left on and hands clear.
comparison.reason: Both tasks adjust to a measured target, but this uses translational wedge insertion under load and has no screw/nut counterholding or cycle-retention test.
